source_contract: datatype-sweep/SKILL.md Anomalies: decisive failed action call per failed task, served/full TT teacher forcing top1 agreement over reply and chosen/correct continuation probabilities. A below-band phase attempt covers all actual failures.
cpu_preparation_plan: Refresh completed coordinator snapshot after final scoring and infrastructure reruns; include all actual failures, preserve native/coordinator score distinction, no cherry picking. Resolve first-action ambiguities through root/triage/native evidence before locking cases.

Extract exact raw request and response by response ID and recorded line to private offline case packets, hashes and token provenance; preserve tools, chat template args, messages, reasoning, stop markers and request settings. Never feed verifier/reference material to evaluation agents.

Reconstruct prompt and full chosen reply using pinned tokenizer revision 842da3794eaa0b77d5f08bae87a17459d91ff475 and serving serialization. Native token IDs are absent: record exact native/reconstructed counts and mismatch; count equality does not prove identity. Do not silently truncate long prefixes or replies.

Independently establish correct action from task specification/test evidence and offline reference at the exact pre-call repository state. Keep any gold access confined to offline diagnostics after evaluation; do not paste base gold patch into a later modified state or claim it uniquely correct. Until validated, correct branch is unavailable and full anomaly requirement remains pending.

Build private full-reply chosen and validated-correct token cases; identical prompt IDs across branches, and identical branch IDs/windows across precisions. Preserve original reasoning context explicitly if using action-only replacement; this is counterfactual conditional on possibly faulty reasoning, not an alternative successful trajectory.

Use precision_repro_batch --validate-only on CPU-prepared manifest/config for schema only. After device is released and root authorizes inference, serialize batch1 served and full-TT loads, all cases with same IDs; full precision BF16 weights/activations/head and HiFi4. Verify runtime precision propagation including SDPA and KV/CCL; no default modification.

Report per-task whole-chosen-reply top1 agreement, per-position chosen/correct log probabilities and sums, scored lengths, trace evidence, runtime config and uncertainties. All-case served/full batches compare with --compare-dir. Keep diagnostic host-logit timing out of serving_rates.

If agreement rules precision out, record one phase anomaly entry listing all failed tasks and precise limits; if disagreement, follow group/layer bisection and rerun/remeasure procedure. Existing three anomaly controls remain separately required; no speculative scoring, pending/results/learned edits, or agent feedback.
scientific_limits: Native raw prompt/output token IDs are null; request logging permits faithful text reconstruction, not proof of exact sampled-token identity. Tool-call protocol reconstruction is harder than GPQA boxed-letter reconstruction.
Prior GPQA case_manifest offers provenance/schema only, not SWE ground truth: original reasoning plus answer-letter substitution does not generalize to multi-line patch actions.

Correct patch branch must condition on actual pre-call file state; task reference applies to base commit and earlier edits may invalidate it. A passing final patch alone does not prove a single locally correct action at the selected call.

Full chosen reply is required for over-reply agreement. A shortened onset window is supplementary and must report its limits. Correct and chosen branches can differ substantially in length; raw sequence probabilities penalize length, so provide lengths/per-token distributions and avoid interpreting unnormalized cross-branch probability as success odds.

Probabilities are untempered full-vocabulary softmax, not native top-k/top-p served sampling probabilities. Batch1 TF cannot reproduce batch32 scheduling or mixed-prefill host sampling; label precision isolation accordingly.

No unique numeric threshold for semantic precision irrelevance is specified here; high aggregate agreement can hide decisive action-token divergence. Inspect differences at decision tokens, not only mean agreement.
